body: Does it conduct business in Indiana OR produce products or services targeted to Indiana residents?

During the applicable calendar year, does it control or process personal data of at least 100,000 consumers; OR at least 25,000 consumers AND derive strictly more than 50% of gross revenue from selling personal data?
Indiana consumers in their individual/household role, not commercial or employment roles. The statute's consumer definition, not an undifferentiated database of residents, controls the count.
Measuring period: During the applicable calendar year.
